Meet Again: Heartwell

Support This Game



Meet Again: Heartwell is a  narrative adventure dating sim with relaxing café minigames. Customize your character, explore the top-down pixel art town map, make crepes, decorate your room, and navigate new friendships and romance in a new town.

More Characters coming soon...

More Characters coming soon...

After College - 2016

Coming soon...

You and your sister visit the isolated island of Heartwell for spring break to dog-sit for your mother. 

There, you meet Marsh and Jade, fraternal twins whose relationship is strained in ways they refuse to talk about. Marsh is guarded and withdrawn. Jade is warm and playful. Getting to know them reveals how different they are and how far apart they’ve grown.

As you spend time on the island, something begins to feel off. You experience headaches, dizzy spells, and an unsettling ability to “read” others, hearing thoughts that feel too clear to be your own.

Your time together is short, but meaningful. You promise to stay in touch, yet somehow, you lose contact...

Years later, you return to Heartwell determined to reconnect, understand what pulled the twins apart, and uncover the truth behind the island that keeps slipping out of reach.

Split your days between story events and free time. Hang out with friends, help at the café, or shop for new customization options. Each choice brings you closer to your favorite characters while revealing more about Heartwell’s secrets.


Coming soon...

  • Customize your main character's appearance and personality
  • Customize your sister’s look and decorate your cafe and apartment
  • Relaxing food prep minigames: crepes, icecream, and more
  • Explore the town of Heartwell in a top-down pixel art walkable map. Interact with characters, objects, and secrets
  • Choose your love interest and watch your relationship grow over time
  • No farming or combat, just story, connection, and self-expression
  • Uncover the town's mysteries…

I’ve always loved otome games, dating sims, and life sims. Romance in games has been a lifelong favorite of mine. The biggest inspiration for Meet Again: Heartwell came from playing Our Life: Beginnings & Always. It was the first time I felt truly connected to characters in a game, and it became a comforting escape during some hard moments in my own life.

That experience made me wonder: what if there were a game with that same warm, genuine romance but presented in cute top-down pixel art, where you can actually walk around and interact with the world? I adore titles like Fields of Mistria and Stardew Valley, but I’ve realized I’m far more drawn to the relationships than to farming or combat. Those games understandably don’t center romance the way I wish they did.

I’m also a fan of cozy food-making minigames like Galaxy Burger and Good Pizza, Great Pizza. That inspired me to add a part-time café job in Meet Again: Heartwell, where players can prepare orders to earn money and unlock new cosmetics. It’s a light, relaxing activity that breaks up the story and adds an extra layer of charm.

So I’m building the game I’ve always wanted to play. A place for people like me who crave heartfelt connections and meaningful relationship building. Meet Again: Heartwell is my way of sharing that dream with anyone else who feels the same

We’re an indie dev couple: Sad Slime Games (aka Pixel Pete) and Alien Puppy Games (that’s me!). Pixel Pete has over 10 years of experience in the gaming industry and has successfully released two indie titles: Blacksea Odyssey and Dwerve. He's currently working on his latest game, The Last Phoenix, while also helping bring Meet Again: Heartwell to life. He even runs a YouTube channel (PixelPete), sharing pixel art and Unity tutorials. Needless to say, I’ve got an all-star by my side!

As for me, I’m handling the writing, art, and game design, while Pixel Pete tackles programming. We may be a small team of two, but we're determined to deliver a fun, wholesome experience we hope you'll love!

By the way, PixelPete made a video showing off the map that will be in Meet Again, check it out below!
